$comment: Public salary and remuneration disclosure rules read by compliance.salary_disclosure.statute (docs/25 §10.1). CanDo drafts the list from amounts paid by the statute's definitions; HR and finance review it and the organization's route approves it before publication. Every entry is verify_at_load until checked against the statute; an organization that needs a statute with no entry adds it with HR, never from code.

ON_PSSDA.name_en: Ontario Public Sector Salary Disclosure Act, 1996
ON_PSSDA.who: Ontario public sector employers covered by the Act
ON_PSSDA.basis: salary paid and taxable benefits in the calendar year
ON_PSSDA.publishes: name, position, salary paid, taxable benefits

BC_FIA_REMUNERATION.name_en: BC Financial Information Act: schedule of employee remuneration and expenses
BC_FIA_REMUNERATION.who: Public bodies the Act names (including municipalities and other local public bodies)
BC_FIA_REMUNERATION.basis: remuneration paid in the fiscal year, with expenses
BC_FIA_REMUNERATION.cite: Financial Information Act (BC) and its regulation; UBCM, Amendment to SOFI reporting legislation (threshold still $75,000)

BC_PSEC_EXECUTIVE.name_en: BC public sector executive compensation disclosure
BC_PSEC_EXECUTIVE.who: Public sector employers under the Public Sector Employers Act
BC_PSEC_EXECUTIVE.basis: executive compensation as the Public Sector Employers' Council's guidelines define it
BC_PSEC_EXECUTIVE.cite: Public Sector Employers Act (BC); BC government, Executive compensation disclosures

BC_SOCIETIES_ACT.name_en: BC Societies Act: remuneration disclosure in the financial statements
BC_SOCIETIES_ACT.who: Societies under the BC Societies Act
BC_SOCIETIES_ACT.basis: remuneration paid to directors, and to employees and contractors paid at least the threshold (up to ten highest)
BC_SOCIETIES_ACT.cite: Societies Act (BC), s. 36; secondary: Canadian Council of Christian Charities, Remuneration disclosure obligations of B.C.'s new Societies Act

FN_FNFTA.name_en: First Nations Financial Transparency Act: schedule of remuneration and expenses
FN_FNFTA.basis: remuneration and expenses paid to the chief and each councillor
FN_FNFTA.publishes: schedule with the audited financial statements
FN_FNFTA.cite: First Nations Financial Transparency Act (Canada), s. 5
